description: Dapper - a simple object mapper for .Net

latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Fix 2.1.86 unbox-gate regressions: array columns to interface members, sql_variant to primitives by @mgravell in https://github.com/DapperLib/Dapper/pull/2271
* Fix command disposal, parameter callbacks, handler-cache staleness, static properties, and type-map races by @mgravell in https://github.com/DapperLib/Dapper/pull/2272
* Fix deserializer cache race by @jnm2 in https://github.com/DapperLib/Dapper/pull/2219
* Fix cache corruption due to CollectCacheGarbage call during GridReader/Async queries by @aklein53 in https://github.com/DapperLib/Dapper/pull/2218
* Fix false cache hit accounting on initial MultiMapAsync execution by @Nacl-HCl in https://github.com/DapperLib/Dapper/pull/2242
* Fixes QueryMultiple corrupting a later Query<T>'s DynamicParameters -- fixes #243, #2091 by @NadeemAfana in https://github.com/DapperLib/Dapper/pull/2214
* Don't cancel the command after QueryUnbufferedAsync completes normally by @aaronwilliams-tesouro in https://github.com/DapperLib/Dapper/pull/2245
* Preserve Size set by type handlers for string parameters by @JiuYue0820 in https://github.com/DapperLib/Dapper/pull/2221
* Fix MultiMapAsync disposing the reader before unbuffered results are enumerated by @jinseojang0903 in https://github.com/DapperLib/Dapper/pull/2229
* Stop boxing values read via GetFieldValue<T> for the error message by @Giorgi in https://github.com/DapperLib/Dapper/pull/2265
* Fix list initializer in bulk Execute README example by @dajiaohuang in https://github.com/DapperLib/Dapper/pull/2243

## New Contributors
* @aklein53 made their first contribution in https://github.com/DapperLib/Dapper/pull/2218
* @Nacl-HCl made their first contribution in https://github.com/DapperLib/Dapper/pull/2242
* @NadeemAfana made their first contribution in https://github.com/DapperLib/Dapper/pull/2214
* @aaronwilliams-tesouro made their first contribution in https://github.com/DapperLib/Dapper/pull/2245
* @JiuYue0820 made their first contribution in https://github.com/DapperLib/Dapper/pull/2221
* @jinseojang0903 made their first contribution in https://github.com/DapperLib/Dapper/pull/2229
* @dajiaohuang made their first contribution in https://github.com/DapperLib/Dapper/pull/2243

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/DapperLib/Dapper/compare/2.1.89...2.1.100
